remarks: NEW PHASE OF BIRDSONG! This is a To Be Built Home planned on a beautiful neighborhood street in Birdsong Estates! Open and airy describes this home to a T. Note the convenience of a First Floor Primary Suite. As soon as you walk through the front door, your attention is grabbed by the direct view of the two-story Great Room with full wall of windows. A Home Office and Dining Room at the front of the house provide for easy entertaining while the rear is filled with everyday living space. Your gourmet kitchen is spacious enough for two chefs and features a generous amount of quartz counter space. The Secondary Entry provides easy access to a Walk-in Pantry and Laundry Room. The First Floor Owner's suite features a private spa bath and a large walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, a full bath and loft make up the 2nd floor. 9'-0 ceilings are standard on the first floor too!
